name: Launch Pack
description: Palette commands for shipping a launch end to end: Product Hunt kit, Hacker News post, launch-week calendar, press kit, and post-launch retro.
author: REX

commands.title: Launch: Product Hunt kit
commands.prompt: Create a complete Product Hunt launch kit for this project: tagline options (60 chars), description, maker comment, 5 gallery image concepts, first-comment FAQ, hunter outreach message, and an hour-by-hour launch-day plan.

commands.title: Launch: Show HN post
commands.prompt: Write a Show HN post for this project in the HN house style: plain title, honest technical first comment, what's novel, limitations, and how to try it. Also list likely tough questions with answers.

commands.title: Launch: Launch-week content calendar
commands.prompt: Create a 7-day launch-week content calendar across X, LinkedIn, Reddit, newsletter, and short video, with full copy for each post.

commands.title: Launch: Press kit
commands.prompt: Write a press kit for this project: boilerplate, founder bio, key facts, 3 story angles, press release, and a pitch email to journalists.

commands.title: Launch: Post-launch retro
commands.prompt: Run a post-launch retrospective for this project. Results so far:
